vo_open.text: In 1919, a wave of molasses flooded Boston.

vo.text: One tank held eight point seven million liters of molasses.
vo.cap: One tank: *8.7 million liters* of molasses.

vo.text: It burst. A wave up to eight meters high raced through the streets at fifty-six kilometers an hour.
vo.cap: It *burst.* A wave up to *8 m* high. *56 km/h.*

vo.text: Warm molasses flows fast. But in the cold air it thickened, and trapped people like glue.
vo.cap: In the cold, it *thickened*... and trapped people *like glue.*

vo.text: Twenty-one people died. A hundred and fifty were injured.
For decades, locals said the area still smelled of molasses on hot summer days.
vo.cap: For *decades*, the area still smelled of molasses on hot days.
